kind: Selected pure contract fixtures; original preparatory expected semantics retained, old gate/device snapshot superseded

cases.setup_or_action: Workflow has draft.write for exact draft D and no import.publish; stage result with target.draft_id=D.
cases.expected_contract_result: Preparation/replacement of D is permitted within current scope; direct POST /imports is denied, never publication by staging.

cases.setup_or_action: Replace ready draft D using upload bound to null or another draft, even as owner.
cases.expected_contract_result: INVALID_REQUEST; do not retarget the sealed handle, alter base, or change either draft history.

cases.setup_or_action: Use context.write to stage a question/body action; or consume a body/metadata object under another action/operation.
cases.expected_contract_result: Existing action-specific authority and closed target are required. context.write is insufficient; wrong consumer cannot adopt.

cases.setup_or_action: Stored context target has render R1; submit omitted/R2 query render. Also test explicit JSON-null tuple, empty/duplicate query fields and literal page null.
cases.expected_contract_result: Omission becomes null, never inherits R1. Exact tuple must match; wrong/empty/duplicate binding is INVALID_REQUEST. Literal page null names a file, not null sentinel.

cases.setup_or_action: Try result/object or context/directory purpose-mode mismatch and unknown action variants/target fields.
cases.expected_contract_result: Reject before staging; result accepts directory/archive/file, other purposes require object. No generic upload-admin or publisher authority.

cases.setup_or_action: One command final key I, upload-create U and seal S; intentionally reuse I on another route or omit/malformed required key.
cases.expected_contract_result: I/U/S are distinct persisted canonical UUID keys. Reusing a principal key for another route conflicts; missing key 428, malformed/quoted/multiple keys 400.

cases.setup_or_action: Lose create/seal/final response, including before final I has a server receipt.
cases.expected_contract_result: Recover original caller journal phase/target/base, preparation receipts and checkpoints. GET operations 404 never proves no work ran; no blind fresh ID.

cases.setup_or_action: POST uploads key U carries target.operation_id Q for future body/metadata consumer; replay U with changed Q.
cases.expected_contract_result: U differs from Q and S; matching original target is valid. Changing Q under U is OPERATION_CONFLICT. Future consumer must match action/target/Q.

cases.setup_or_action: Complete same active checkpoint with S1 and new S2, then use identical sealed checkpoint; try different checkpoint while sealing.
cases.expected_contract_result: S2 owns a completed 202 receipt linking the one existing upload_seal job. Sealed identical new request returns 200. Different active checkpoint is INVALID_TRANSITION; replay retains original response.
cases.later_owner: TASK-002-02 ledger; TASK-002-04 seal; TASK-002-05 HTTP

cases.setup_or_action: Replay same import intent through a different sealed upload with equal payload/submitted metadata; then change title/base/explicit metadata under same I.
cases.expected_contract_result: Reuse once-captured normalization context for equivalent content, not upload transport ID/time. Changed semantic request returns OPERATION_CONFLICT; no saved default masks changed intent.

cases.setup_or_action: POST imports with document_id omitted, null, existing D, or mismatching upload target.
cases.expected_contract_result: Omission is 400 INVALID_REQUEST; null is new-document intent with one allocated ID; existing D remains exact target. No server remembered-document fallback.

cases.setup_or_action: Normal client captures base B before upload; another operation publishes C before import.
cases.expected_contract_result: VERSION_CONFLICT with no silent attachment to C. Keep reusable exact-target staging; deliberate changed base uses a new final operation.

cases.setup_or_action: Low-level API deliberately omits existing-document base; latest changes before and after first valid import reservation.
cases.expected_contract_result: Capture base once at POST imports reservation, not create/seal. Replays use saved base/omission markers; committed response replays before stale preconditions are reevaluated.

cases.setup_or_action: Resolve explicit document/project/new-document versus remembered association; target is denied/missing.
cases.expected_contract_result: Only client launcher applies package precedence. Explicit project alone clears remembered document; new-document sends null; denied/missing selections never become new-document fallback.

cases.setup_or_action: Fresh operation/current base targets existing explicit version V with identical immutable metadata/payload, then changed bytes.
cases.expected_contract_result: Identical authorized version returns 200. Changed immutable bytes returns 409 IMMUTABLE_VERSION_CONFLICT, distinct from stale base/changed operation/hash mismatch.

cases.setup_or_action: Cancel upload_seal before commit while worker still may finalize.
cases.expected_contract_result: Fence attempt; keep upload sealing until confirmed stop/reconciliation. Then cancelled job/open non-abandoned upload retains accepted bytes/checkpoints. New verification uses new key/job.
cases.later_owner: TASK-002-02 fencing; TASK-002-04 seal; TASK-002-05 API

cases.setup_or_action: Seal commit wins before cancel.
cases.expected_contract_result: Keep job completed and upload sealed; report already completed. Cancel does not reverse seal/publication.

cases.setup_or_action: Abandon while sealing.
cases.expected_contract_result: Atomically abandoned; fence writes/adoption/finalization, record cancel intent. Set job cancelled only after confirmed stop; retain active/recovery pins.

cases.setup_or_action: Abandon already sealed/adopted staging.
cases.expected_contract_result: Prevent new reuse but retain adopted version/context and active/unknown pins. Completed seal job is not rewritten cancelled.
cases.later_owner: TASK-002-02/04; actual adopted records later EPIC-005/006

cases.setup_or_action: Delayed failed seal result arrives after abandonment.
cases.expected_contract_result: Upload remains abandoned; late worker cannot reopen/finalize; settlement waits for confirmed worker stop.

cases.setup_or_action: Crash during cancel/abandon; recover same persisted fence/upload/job.
cases.expected_contract_result: Reconcile coupled state before writes reopen or pins release. No early open; cancelled job never resumes. Idle/mobile/delivery loss does not abandon staging.

cases.setup_or_action: Owner GET uploads list, including source credential loss.
cases.expected_contract_result: Cursor summary fields exactly from canonical table plus detail_url; no checkpoint/error/ranges in list. Current owner authority, not old bearer possession, permits discovery.

cases.setup_or_action: Expand item or prepare Resume via detail_url.
cases.expected_contract_result: Detail adds checkpoint/ranges_url/entries_url/error and nullable seal job/operation/content/object fields. Pins/ranges/entries are cursor resources; absent list error is not verified success.

cases.setup_or_action: Sealed staging loses bytes/current authority, or adoption transfers ownership; apply age-only cleanup.
cases.expected_contract_result: sealed is verification state, reusable additionally requires current authority and every byte available/pinnable. Preserve pins/adopted references; no new missing upload state or age-only abandonment.

cases.setup_or_action: GET/PUT the three owner personal reader resources on absent and stored state.
cases.expected_contract_result: Absent responses carry the exact default visible value with explicit null revision/etag keys and required_precondition if_none_match_star; stored values (including a stored default) keep exists true with a real validator. The reading-position response always carries page_position_url: the once-encoded canonical page link, or explicit null for a whole-version pointer, never lending the pointer validator to that resource.

future_UI_actions.contract: GET /versions/{id}/package or /file?path=..., authenticated stream to the supported destination; personal-record portability is the labelled host-local CLI export path
Exact page URL wins. Continue reads the version last-opened pointer; page navigation writes GET/PUT /versions/{id}/reading-position with page_path, page_query, page_fragment and opened
GET/PUT /versions/{id}/reader-preference, default_page path or null, using that record's individual precondition. Does not republish or move the last-opened pointer
GET/PUT /versions/{id}/page-position?page={path}, page_query/page_fragment/position with the page record's own ETag. Never reuse the version pointer or another page's validator
Existing individual review, revisit and annotation GET/mutation routes; explicit owner actions and per-record ETags
POST /versions/{id}/questions with the remembered/default or explicit source mode; GET version questions / GET /questions/{id} only reads saved history
Progressively merge two path-ordered GET /versions/{id}/files cursors plus metadata/file reads; show complete versus unfinished/unavailable diff scope
POST /findings/{id}/decisions with its If-Match; POST /overlays/{id}/undo with current overlay validator
POST /generations with finding_id, expected_finding_revision, intent=draft and existing authorized generation scope. Never implicitly approves or publishes the finding
POST /scans with finding_id and expected_finding_revision plus captured allowed scope/depth/target. A stale finding is not force-applied
PATCH /drafts/{id} with If-Match: action=reject for preparing/ready; action=replace plus sealed upload_id and optional metadata_ref for ready. Publish uses the separate POST /drafts/{id}/publish

GET /configuration and project-scoped POST /configuration/plans (scope.kind=project, project_id), then existing plan commit; source_mode_default is pinned/current, initially pinned. Use remembered authorized choices, not a remote filesystem browser
